disclosure.scope: Authored analysis and aggregate diagnostics only. No upstream rows, raw files, event/equity series or browser full text redistribution.

limitations: Already exposed one-day development file; no holdout or independent economic validation.
Close signal and next-open/terminal-close execution prices are explicit proxies, not actual fill or limit queue evidence.
FIFO nonterminal realized price PnL is not exchange paired grid-cycle profit.
Actual funding, fees, mark-equity and net PnL remain unknown.
Time-varying inventory differs from static hold; no alpha ranking or selected strategy.
Current work lacks a sealed future/cross-day contract supported by installed formal evaluator; method selftest does not confer production replay status.
Source event completeness and same-millisecond executable ordering unknown; minute-sampled drawdown may miss intraminute risk.

provenance.execution_environment: Official Codex app delegated local Python computation; no model/market API, no account or order
provenance.reason: Actual scheduler-event identity not exposed; prompt and wall clock are not natural-trigger proof.

results.primary_result: Modeled trading friction, rather than terminal residual inventory, flips both grid price components negative in this sample.
